_about: Dates the website should prepare for. Every Monday a GitHub Action (.github/workflows/seasonal-reminders.yml) opens an issue for each event whose reminder date has arrived, with the ideas and checklist below. 'when' can be 'MM-DD', 'last sunday of october', 'second sunday of november', or 'easter-21' (days from Easter Sunday). 'remind_days_before' should leave about three weeks for Google to find a new page. Ask Claude Code to add, remove or change events here.

ideas: Fireworks, trauma and C-PTSD: why loud bangs can feel so big, and what can help
